# Mermaid.js v11.12.2 — third-party code attribution

The files in this directory are the compiled Mermaid.js **11.12.2** front-end JavaScript module and its flowchart dependencies, copied from the locally installed Gradio front-end distribution, retaining upstream filenames and bytes. They are vendored for self-hosted local use with a strict same-origin CSP; no CDN or job-data web lookup is necessary.

Mermaid is licensed under the **MIT License**; original project: https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid (Copyright (c) Knut Sveidqvist and contributors). Other embedded packages include Svelte (MIT), Dagre (MIT), and D3-related libraries (BSD-family licenses). The compiled assets originated in the Gradio (Apache-2.0) front-end; preserve upstream notices and review third-party notices if redistributing the package. The original compiled `*.js` files are not edited here. `mermaid-entry.js` is a site-specific wrapper; the two empty CSS preload placeholders intentionally omit Gradio global styling.
